t: What is a Time-Based One-Time Password? | Definition from TechTarget

t: What is a Time-based One-time Password (TOTP)? | Twilio
s: A standardized algorithm that uses the device time as an input and generates unique numeric passwords. A Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) serves as a form of two-factor authentication (2FA). Other terms for TOTP include app-based authentication, software tokens, or soft tokens.
